## Attempt: search for a surviving non-Tate motive

Let

\[
f:\mathcal M_{7,4}\longrightarrow \mathcal M_7
\]

forget the four ordered markings. Over a smooth genus-seven curve \(C\), its fiber is the ordered configuration space

\[
F(C,4)=C^4\setminus\bigcup_{i<j}\Delta_{ij}.
\]

The Leray spectral sequence is

\[
E_2^{p,q}=H^p(\mathcal M_7,R^qf_*\mathbf Q)\Longrightarrow H^{p+q}(\mathcal M_{7,4};\mathbf Q).
\]

The exact ordinary target from the packet is

\[
W_{28}H^{28}(\mathcal M_{7,4})(22),
\]

which is equivalent by Poincare duality in dimension \(22\) to

\[
W_{-16}H^{BM}_{16}(\mathcal M_{7,4}).
\]

Write \(\mathbb V=R^1\pi_*\mathbf Q\) for the standard weight-one symplectic variation on \(\mathcal M_7\). Before imposing the diagonal-complement relations, the Kunneth decomposition of \(H^4(C^4)\) contains

\[
H^1(C)^{\otimes4}.
\]

Thus the only evident place in this forgetful-map analysis where a genuinely non-Tate motive could contribute with total degree and weight \(28\) is a nontrivial symplectic-local-system summand of

\[
W_{24}H^{24}(\mathcal M_7,\mathbb V^{\otimes4})
\subseteq E_2^{24,4}.
\]

Indeed, the coefficient variation has weight \(4\), so its weight-24 base contribution would have total weight \(28\), and \(24+4=28\). The invariant contraction summands of \(\mathbb V^{\otimes4}\) are Tate and therefore cannot themselves disprove the target; a counterexample would have to lie in a nontrivial irreducible symplectic summand.

This does not produce a counterexample. Passing from \(C^4\) to \(F(C,4)\) introduces diagonal Gysin relations, and the supplied packet gives no computation showing that a chosen nontrivial summand of \(\mathbb V^{\otimes4}\) survives in \(R^4f_*\mathbf Q\). Even if it does, one must still establish a nonzero non-Tate class in the exact group \(W_{24}H^{24}(\mathcal M_7,-)\), control all Leray differentials entering or leaving \(E_r^{24,4}\), and rule out extensions or cancellations before obtaining a class in \(W_{28}H^{28}(\mathcal M_{7,4})\).

No such survival or nonvanishing theorem is present in the supplied files. Therefore no non-Tate summand has been exhibited in the exact target, and this attempt is incomplete. In particular, it does not refute the expected Tate type \(\mathbf Q(-14)\) before twisting, or \(\mathbf Q(8)\) in Borel–Moore homology.
assumptions: Standard Leray and mixed-Hodge-structure functoriality for the forgetful morphism of smooth Deligne-Mumford stacks.
The standard variation V=R^1 pi_*Q has weight one.

claims.statement: Forgetting the four ordered markings gives a Leray spectral sequence with fiber the ordered configuration space F(C,4), and any class relevant to the ordinary target has total degree 28.
The Kunneth term H^1(C)^{\otimes4} identifies W_24 H^24(M_7,V^{\otimes4}) in bidegree (24,4) as a possible source of total-degree-28, total-weight-28 non-Tate classes.
A nontrivial irreducible symplectic-local-system summand survives the diagonal relations into R^4f_*Q.
The relevant nontrivial summand has nonzero non-Tate W_24 H^24 on M_7.
A resulting class survives every Leray differential and defines a non-Tate summand of W_28 H^28(M_7,4)(22), equivalently W_-16 H^BM_16(M_7,4).

gap_markers: No equivariant computation of R^4f_*Q is supplied, so survival of a nontrivial summand of V^{\otimes4} through the diagonal Gysin relations is unproved.
No nonvanishing or Hodge-type calculation for W_24 H^24(M_7,L) with the required nontrivial symplectic local system L is supplied.
No analysis of Leray differentials or extensions proves that a candidate E_2 class reaches W_28 H^28(M_7,4).
No surviving non-Tate summand in the exact Borel–Moore target has been exhibited.
summary: The forgetful-map Leray spectral sequence isolates a possible source of non-Tate weight-28 classes in degree 28, namely weight-24 cohomology of M_7 with nontrivial summands of the fourth tensor power of the standard symplectic local system. The supplied packet contains no calculation proving that such a class exists, survives the configuration-space diagonal relations, and reaches the abutment. Consequently this approach neither refutes nor proves the Tate target.
